responsibility: Main x86 RTL machine-description file for IA-32 and x86-64 code generation, defining the backend's core instruction patterns, unspec/unspecv enums, and expander helpers for scalar, MMX, SSE, AVX, wait/serialization, AMX tile, and other target instructions. It is the central lowering and assembly-output description that turns GCC RTL and builtin expansions into actual x86 instruction forms, and it pulls in companion SIMD pattern fragments such as mmx.md, sse.md, and sync.md.
same_name_distinction: The machine-description member of the i386 group: unlike i386.cc and i386.h, which are C++ source/header files, this .md file encodes RTL instruction patterns, unspec enums, and includes of pattern fragments; unlike i386.opt it is not for command-line option definitions.
